question: Should the bundled Policy plugin permanently expose authored routing probes and their associated Doctor check IDs as a supported operator-facing policy contract?
rationale: The patch is deliberately opt-in and has strong contributor proof, but choosing whether this new policy language belongs in the bundled plugin is a maintainer product and long-term compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Sponsor the bundled Policy contract
options.body: Accept the opt-in routing section and review the documented probe/check-ID/evidence semantics as a supported Policy surface.

options.title: Defer the product surface
options.body: Keep the routing-conformance idea unmerged until an owner defines a narrower or externalized extension path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bundled Policy contract
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in routing section and review the documented probe/check-ID/evidence semantics as a supported Policy surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review context only identifies the author/reporter as the person directly connected to this proposed Policy-routing surface; repository-history ownership could not be established independently.
